g.text: CUT 5V FWD IF PERIPH HAS OWN 5V

svg.text: Onboard U1 channel1: 3.3 V A → 5 V B
Source nearest-pad pitch: Prime 1.27 mm; extension 1.27 mm. Depicted pitch: 20 mm.
Connect same numbered contacts; pin numbers govern continuity, not a guessed ribbon stripe.
Source: two-row native solder-pad centres. Depiction: one column, 20 mm pitch; symbols are electrical, not mating faces.
Source-default JP1 1–2: A → B; JP8 1–2: VCCB = host5V. No external power.
J1.3 / PB1 → U1.3 / A; U1.4 / B → J2.3. This is an active translator, not a passive wire.
U1 VCCA=host3V3, VCCB=host5V, GND common. R1/R8 are100k pull-downs; C1/C8 are100nF.
Configure PB1 as a digital output. Voltmeter reads B1 relative to ground; this is not a load-driving qualification.
JP9/JP10 forward5V/3V3 to J2.2/J2.1, both UNUSED. J3 external supply remains disconnected.
Other J2 signals unused; source-default channels A→B. Never drive B side in this selected direction.
J2.1/2 forwarded rails and J2.4–9 unused; no chain or external supply connected.
Physical connector orientation / fitted cable and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN. No hardware qualification.
